items.t: Jacksonville dog owner sentenced to six years in prison after man mauled to death in 2024
items.x: Despite receiving multiple warnings to contain his animals, police determined Melvyn Souffrount's dog killed a man on Ricker Road in August 2024.

items.t: Iran war's cost to American taxpayers grows to an estimated $47.1 billion
items.x: The cost of the Iran war to American taxpayers has grown to an estimated $47.1 billion, the Pentagon told Congress.

items.t: Jacksonville firefighter, nurse wife survive deadly Spain train crash, then treat the injured
items.x: JFRD firefighter Josue Garcia-Otero was traveling with his wife and family on a post-wedding trip when tragedy struck. That's when JFRD said his training took over.

items.t: RFK Jr. eases access to unproven peptides despite opposition from FDA scientists
items.x: The Trump administration has acted to ease access to unproven peptide drugs favored by Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.

items.t: Ocala Christian Academy teacher arrested for taking pictures up student’s skirt, officers say
items.x: A fifth-grade teacher at Ocala Christian Academy was arrested after Ocala police accused him of taking inappropriate pictures up a student’s skirt

items.t: King tides inundate streets and flood homes and businesses along both US coasts
items.x: King tides have inundated parts of both U.S. coasts.

items.t: ‘I miss her like crazy’: Loved ones remembering post office worker hit and killed by car
items.x: Loved ones and a Kentucky community are mourning a post office worker who was hit and killed by a car while walking earlier this month.

items.t: Conservative activists O'Keefe, Higby charged with unlawful voting in Minnesota
items.x: Conservative activists James O’Keefe and Cam Higby have been charged with unlawful voting and identity theft in Minnesota after a prosecutor said they gave false names to poll workers during the state's primary election.

items.t: Alachua County schools superintendent under state Ethics Commission investigation
items.x: Alachua County Public Schools Superintendent Kamela Patton is being investigated by the Florida Commission on Ethics

items.t: Grandmother not indicted in baby’s death after police say she left him in hot car for 8 hours while she worked
items.x: A Madisonville grand jury declined to indict a Kentucky doctor after her 10-month-old grandchild died in a hot car, police said.

items.t: Ernie Johnson announces this will be his final season on ‘Inside The NBA’
items.x: Ernie Johnson announced he will be stepping down as host of “Inside the NBA” at the end of the season.

items.t: Despite much-criticized early tipoff, Dream say WNBA Finals Game 6 against Valkyries is a sellout
items.x: The Atlanta Dream say Thursday’s WNBA Finals Game 6 against the Golden State Valkyries is a sellout despite its much-criticized 12:30 p.m. Eastern tipoff.

items.t: Coastal Flood Warnings continue, Increasing rain chances this weekend
items.x: Rain chances rise Halloween night through Monday with heaviest rain late Sunday into Monday

items.t: Duval County early voting sign vandalized to remove Spanish voting instructions
items.x: A Duval County polling place sign was vandalized to remove Spanish-language voting instructions, Duval County Supervisor of Elections Jerry Holland said in a Facebook post on Wednesday.

items.t: Police department closes its investigation into Hayden Panettiere’s death
items.x: The Greenville Police Department said it has officially closed its investigation into the death of Hayden Panettiere.

items.t: Rays ace Drew Rasmussen to start World Series Game 5 on short rest against Milwaukee
items.x: Drew Rasmussen will start for Tampa Bay on three days’ rest in Game 5 of the World Series against the Milwaukee Brewers on Wednesday night, trying to stave off elimination for the Rays.

items.t: Indiana governor is urged to let death sentence proceed against man who killed 2 kids in fire
items.x: The Indiana Parole Board is recommending that the death penalty remain in place for a man who killed two children in a house fire.

items.t: Two Michigan WWII veterans celebrate 99th birthdays together
items.x: David Low and Marv Nagelkerk, who served in the Marine Corps and Navy during World War II, were honored by friends and fellow veterans on their 99th birthday.

items.t: Trump says US will beat China in AI as technology emerges
items.x: Artificial intelligence has emerged as the critical sticking point between the U.S. and China. President Donald Trump, who has named it “super intelligence,” insists the U.S. will beat China in the AI competition.

items.t: Gainesville man sentenced to 25 years in federal prison for drug trafficking
items.x: Trai Williams, 28, pleaded guilty in July to possession with intent to distribute more than 100 grams of carfentanil and other controlled substances.
